900.3.10(369).explanation: Site-specific RD exception: side setbacks are 0.9 m (3.6 m where the side lot line abuts a street); lots fronting Brimley Rd. need 22.0 m from the original street centreline; garages must be at least 0.3 m from an interior side lot line. No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.3.10(692).explanation: Site-specific RD exception: the minimum lot frontage and lot area are those that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted; side setbacks are 4.5 m on a street side and 1.2 m otherwise; front setbacks of 22.0 to 30.0 m apply from the original centre line of named roads, and 68.0 m from the Highway 401 centreline; the lands must also comply with exception 1462; lots 45 and 46 of Registered Plan 2129 need 15.0 m frontage and 929 m2 lot area. Part of the lands is governed by a former City of Scarborough by-law exception.
